summary_en: Kadoya Sesame Mills' board confirmed support for ITG-G Holdings' public tender offer while disclosing receipt of a competing binding proposal from Candidate C (a fund). The special committee and board maintain their endorsement of the ITG-G offer and will comparatively evaluate the Candidate C proposal against existing terms.
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment to "Notice of Expression of Support Opinion and Recommendation for Application regarding Public Tender Offer for our Common Shares by ITG-G Holdings Inc."
translation_en_brief:
On October 28, 2026, Kadoya Sesame Mills announced an update to its public tender offer process initiated by ITG-G Holdings. The company disclosed that it has received a binding proposal dated October 27, 2026, from Candidate C (a fund participating in the acquisition review process) regarding a public tender offer and subsequent squeeze-out delisting transaction.

The company's special committee has evaluated Candidate C's proposal as a qualifying counter-proposal under the public tender offer agreement. Although the board maintains its support for the ITG-G Holdings tender offer and continues to recommend shareholder participation, it stated that it will conduct comparative evaluation of Candidate C's proposal against the existing offer. The board emphasized that evaluation will be comprehensive, considering not only price but also transaction certainty, financing capability, regulatory approval prospects, timing, and post-transaction management policy. No change was announced to the board's endorsement or the special committee's recommendation at this time. The company indicated that further disclosures would follow as developments occur in the evaluation process.
